lockfileVersion.description: Lockfile format version; always 1 for this schema.

extends.description: Content-hash pin of the org baseline fetched via 'extends' (Gap 4). Fail-closed on hash divergence without --update.

url.description: The URL of the org baseline extensions.json that was fetched.

sha256.description: sha256 content hash of the fetched baseline; verified on every non-update install.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the baseline was fetched and pinned.

resolved.description: Map of resolved extension entries, keyed by '<id>@<semver>'.

source.description: Resolved artifact source: npm CDN URL, file:// path, or https:// URL.

checksum.description: sha256 checksum of the resolved artifact; verified on every install.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this entry was resolved.
